unverified_requirements.text: Reconstruct the McLaren GT3 race car shown: low continuous body surfaces, the cockpit and glazing, four wheels and wheel arches, deep front intakes and splitter, side ducts, rear wing and its supports. Match the blue, black and white livery regions and the dominant glazing and tyre materials. Small sponsor lettering and exact logos may be simplified. Wheels, glazing and aerodynamic attachments must remain distinguishable editable components. Do not invent an engine or hidden drivetrain.

unverified_requirements.text: Use real editable three-dimensional geometry. Preserve continuous curvature, thickness, recesses, openings, thin structures, connections and occlusions. Distinct components should be editable objects or clearly separable mesh islands; organic surfaces may remain continuous. Exact source topology, vertex count and object names are not required. Image planes or camera-facing shells are not substitutes for full geometry.
